items.title: Beta 0.8.3 — music player fits
items.body: The Music tab is compact and easier to use: a full-width seek bar, big centred controls, the music volume beside them and more room for lyrics. It always fits, even on small or scaled screens.

items.title: Beta 0.8.2 — tabs fixed
items.body: The tab bar always fits, every screen opens in a window, panels are never cut off, and chats close when you click elsewhere instead of staying stuck.

items.title: Beta 0.8.1 — fixes
items.body: The island no longer closes while your cursor is on it, and its placement (and the chats over the panel) are right again. After opening a chat the island used to lose track of the cursor and its position.
